metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2025 · Witch Hat Atelier
metas.description: The series follows a girl named Coco, who dreams of being a witch, but in her world only those born with magical abilities are able to become witches. However, after meeting a witch named Qifrey, Coco's dream begins to come true.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2025 · The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
metas.description: In Elmore, reality bends and family life gets weird. Gumball pulls Darwin, Anais, and the whole town into adventures - from fighting evil fast food to dealing with an AI crushing on his mom. The show's so wild, it needed a new name.
